svg.title: Tracking e spazi fra parole
svg.desc: Genuine font outlines shaped from the preserved original font with HarfBuzz. Explicit OpenType features and variation axes are recorded in manifest.json. Kerning changes positions, not contours; tracking and word-space values are added increments. No font substitution, geometric stretching, clipping, universal spacing rule or legibility ranking. Historical2025–2026slide figures are reference only, not the font or raster reproduced here. Native editorial captions and rights remain external.
